releaseNotes:
What changed:
- Short dramas now opens on a mix of every category instead of on Love alone, so the
  first screen is a spread rather than one mood. The categories still narrow it, with
  a Mix chip in front of them to come back to.
- Captions in a short drama stay on the screen now. The picture fills a phone by being
  zoomed, and the captions were being cropped away with everything else that fell off
  the edge.

Already on 1.53.0 or newer? This installs itself as usual.

On 1.52.1 or older? 1.53.0 changed the app's identity, so Android will not install this
over your copy and the in-app update stops with "The downloaded update belongs to a
different app." Uninstall GIZTV once, then install this build from the release page.
Watch history does not carry across that one reinstall. Updates after it are automatic.
